messages:
tara: ACME compliance team pinged for an auditable trail: per-route cost rollup + ability to export sampled spans. They need a demo for their security review next month.
sunil: For the demo, can we fake the span export with a small sampled OTLP sink? We don't need full trace UI for now.
zoe: Prefer real data over fake. We can enable a light export to an S3 bucket that emulates customer retention. Keep retention short and encrypted.
eli: Core ask for product: a per-route cost widget (7d) and an export button that yields token-level CSV + sampled spans. Minimal UX only.
 tara: UX note: don't present dollar amounts for Dedicated customers — those have committed pricing. Show token counts + an "estimate" label and export to CSV for audits.
sunil: Tech constraints: our metrics pipeline emits token_count and model_id but doesn't aggregate by route_id at the correct cardinality. We'll need a rolling aggregation job.
zoe: Proposal: cheap MVP = server-side query over recent raw events to build the 7d rollup on demand for route details panel (query-time aggregation) to avoid long-running counters.
eli: That adds latency on first load. Acceptable if cached 10m and we show a loading spinner.
 tara: Acceptance criteria draft:
```
- Route panel shows: route_name, 7d token_count, estimated_cost_USD, p95_latency_ms, error_rate_pct
- CSV export returns: timestamp, request_id, tokens_used, model_variant, route_id
- OTLP export: sampled spans include route_id tag
- Data freshness <= 20m for hosted; explicit "estimated" badge in UI
- Feature behind org-level feature flag with audit log entries for exports
```
sunil: Security: exports must be gated by org role with explicit consent and recorded in audit logs. Also ensure spans don't include PII by default.
zoe: For hosted customers, do not persist raw spans in our UI. Export-only for enterprise orgs with a contract.
eli: Roadmap impact: spike (1 week) to validate query-time aggregation approach, then 2 sprints for API + UI + export infra. Can we compress to one sprint if we scope UI to a single panel and export API only?
 tara: Stakeholder ask: marketing wants a demo by next month. If we compress, we ship a demo with 1 route sample and export working. Not full rollout.
product-bot: Reminder: create PROD-8521 for per-route-cost + export; link to compliance PRD template.
sunil: Deployment plan: feature-flagged rollout 0% -> 2% -> 25% -> 100% with telemetry check. Add a post-rollout job that compares aggregated tokens vs raw event count and fires an alert if mismatch > 10%.
zoe: Edge cases: batched requests and KV cache hits. Aggregation must dedupe cache-serving events to avoid overstating tokens.
eli: Test plan: unit tests for aggregation logic, integration test hitting export API, and a smoke test that runs CSV export and validates schema.
 tara: Decision for today: approve prototype spike and the demo-scope (single-route demo + export). Post-spike we'll re-evaluate full rollout timeline. Please ack in thread. :white_check_mark:
